name: wmkf_potentialreviewers-identity
_comment: Reviewer Identity Resolver Phase 2 PR1 (docs/REVIEWER_IDENTITY_RESOLVER_PHASE2_DESIGN.md §2.5). The deterministic resolver's CURRENT decision, stored on the person. status/confidenceBand are Strings (not Picklists) — lower deploy risk + consistent with the existing String wmkf_emailsource; the resolver (lib/services/reviewer-identity-resolver.js) is the source of truth for valid values (status: confirmed|probable|ambiguous|unresolved|rejected; confidenceBand: high|medium|<null>). verifiedanchorsjson is a compact Memo JSON blob (kept small — cap anchors). Idempotent: ensureAttribute skips existing. Deploy: node scripts/apply-dataverse-schema.js --target=prod --wave=6 --execute

attributes.description: Resolver verdict: confirmed | probable | ambiguous | unresolved | rejected. The single gate for whether identity-bearing fields may persist or count toward ranking.
Display-only band derived from status: high (confirmed) | medium (probable) | empty (ambiguous/unresolved/rejected). Never a sort key.
Semver of the rule set that produced this decision (enables replay/drift measurement).
When the resolver last classified this person.
Human-readable 'why' for the status (anchors that passed/failed, ambiguity).
Compact JSON of the verified anchors backing the decision (canonicalKey/type/sourceUrl/verifier/retrievedAt). Kept small.
